question: How many drones will Russia launch at Ukraine in the overnight attack reported on the morning of September 18, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: nightly Ukrainian Air Force reported drone-launch counts for single overnight attacks in the late-summer/early-autumn 2026 regime. The seven nights I could confirm (92, 108, 121, 162, 163, 167, 218) have a median of 162, so the status-quo outcome is a package in the low-to-mid hundreds. I set the median slightly above the recent median because the last three nights (121, 108, 92) coincide with the Sep 5-8 Kyiv-only pause and should mean-revert by Sep 17-18, and because the distribution is right-skewed. The right tail is the main uncertainty: Russia retains massed-barrage capability (948 drones/24h in March 2026; the 'massive' nine-city strike of Aug 27; Ihnat's >1,500 UAVs over four days in late August, implying a stretch averaging far above early September), so I hold a wide p75-p90 despite every confirmed night in the past two weeks landing under 220. Low tail: no general ceasefire, Russia explicitly rejected one and struck through the partial pause, so near-zero mass is small (~4-5%, covering both a rare no-drone night and a ceasefire taking effect). p_above_upper=0.02 for a >800 retaliatory barrage, a mechanism with 2026 precedent. Evidence is one-sided in one respect worth naming: my nightly series is dense for Sep 1-7 but sparse for Aug 1-25, so the true frequency of 300+ nights in this regime is the weakest part of my estimate, which argues for the wide tail rather than a tighter one.
calls.dossier:
RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off the launched-drone figure in the Ukrainian Air Force (Povitryani Syly) daily summary published the morning of Sep 18, 2026 Kyiv time, covering the night of Sep 17-18 — NOT the shot-down count, NOT missiles, NOT any 24-hour or multi-day aggregate. The UAF publishes this summary every morning, typically with figures stated as of 08:30-09:30 Kyiv time; reports frequently note the attack was still ongoing and data still being refined, so early wire numbers are sometimes revised.

EVENT WINDOW: night of Sep 17 -> morning of Sep 18, 2026, a single overnight attack, per the criteria. As of Now (2026-09-07T08:35Z) the window has not opened; it begins in ~10.6 days. 0% elapsed.

STATUS-QUO OUTCOME: near-nightly Russian drone attacks continue, with a UAF launch figure published each morning.

NIGHTLY UAF LAUNCH COUNTS, recent (each from the UAF daily summary):
- Aug 26-27: 162 (RBC-Ukraine)
- Aug 31-Sep 1: 218 (per question background)
- Sep 2-3: 163 (Liveuamap citing UAF)
- Sep 3-4: 121, ~half jet-powered (Kyiv Independent)
- Sep 4-5: 167, ~half jet-powered; 128 downed (Ukrainska Pravda; Ukrinform)
- Sep 5-6: 108; 88 neutralized (RBC-Ukraine; UNN)
- Sep 6-7: 92; 71 downed (Ukrinform)
BASE RATES: median of these seven confirmed nights ~162; mean ~147. Computed over the Aug 26-Sep 7 2026 window only. CONDITIONAL SPLIT WORTH NOTING: the last three of those nights (121, 108, 92) fall inside the Sep 5-8 partial pause described below; the four nights outside it are 162, 218, 163, 167. Over a longer trailing ~12 months the 10th-90th spread of nightly counts is far wider than the Aug-Sep cluster, roughly 60 to 500.

EVIDENCE THE UPPER TAIL IS LIVE:
- Mar 24-25, 2026: 948 drones in 24 hours, described as the largest aerial attack of the war (All India Radio/newsonair).
- Late Mar 2026: a 270+ drone overnight strike (newsonair).
- Aug 27, 2026: Russia itself called an overnight strike on 9 Ukrainian cities 'massive'; four Kyiv districts hit, Odesa attacked for 7+ hours; no per-night drone count located (ABC/KSAT).
- UAF spokesperson Yurii Ihnat, Aug 31, 2026: Russia launched 'more than 1,500 UAVs' over a four-day period, ~800 of them jet-powered — a multi-night average well above the early-September nightly figures (Ukrainska Pravda).

EVIDENCE THE TYPICAL PACKAGE IS SMALLER THAN 2025:
- Ihnat: Russia used 5x as many jet-powered UAVs in July as June, shifting tactics because petrol-powered drones were being intercepted at 88-90% while jet-powered ones are harder to stop. Jet-powered types now ~half of a typical package.
- Recent packages mix Shahed/Geran, Gerbera, Parodiya decoys and S8000 Banderol, launched from ~5 directions (Millerovo, Oryol, Kursk, occupied Donetsk, Hvardiiske/Crimea).
- 2025 saw repeated 500-700+ drone nights; no night above 218 appears in the confirmed Aug 26-Sep 7 2026 series.

DIPLOMATIC CONTEXT (both directions):
- Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in Moscow Sep 5, then Zelensky in Kyiv Sep 6; both sides agreed to withhold aerial attacks on each other's CAPITALS only for the visit. Russia rejected a wider ceasefire and struck across Ukraine on Sep 6 while avoiding Kyiv city (Al Jazeera, NBC, Washington Post).
- Ukraine ordered a unilateral pause on offensive operations Sep 5-8; it did not stop Russian strikes.
- US pushing for trilateral talks; the Kremlin says a Trump-Putin-Zelensky summit could occur only to 'formalise agreements'. No confirmed summit date located for mid-September.
- No general ceasefire is in force. The Wikipedia entry '2026 Russo-Ukrainian truce' is a disambiguation page listing only PAST April 2026 and May 2026 truces.

MARKETS: no prediction market found whose contract matches this question (threshold, night, UAF-summary source). Polymarket hosts ~20 Ukraine markets but none on nightly drone counts; Ukraine blocked Polymarket domestically in Jan 2026. Manifold carries only loosely related war/ceasefire contracts.

SEARCHED FOR BUT COULD NOT FIND:
- A per-night drone count for the 'massive' Aug 27 strike.
- A systematic night-by-night dataset for Jun-Aug 2026; the Wikipedia war timeline for that period logs Ukrainian strikes on Russia but carries no UAF launch figures for Russian attacks, so the Aug 1-25 series is sparse.
- Any source substantiating the question background's '~2,800 jet-powered drones over the first six days of September 2026'. That figure is in direct tension with the summed nightly UAF reports for those same nights (~870 total including non-jet types); the discrepancy is unresolved and the scope of the 2,800 figure is unknown.
- Any announced Russian operational pause, holiday, or scheduled event falling on Sep 17-18, 2026.
- Any weather forecast bearing on that night (too distant to be informative at this range).
calls.reference_class: Single-night Ukrainian Air Force reported drone-launch totals for Russian overnight attacks, 2026 jet-drone regime (roughly Aug-Sep 2026)

calls.reasoning: Reference class is the Ukrainian Air Force's own nightly launched-drone figure in the current jet-Shahed regime (Aug 1 - Sep 7, 2026), which I sampled at 92, 108, 133, 147, 147, 150, 152, 163, 167, 217, 218, 258 (median ~155, mean ~163) - materially below 2025's 400-800-drone barrages, because Russia has shifted mass toward jet-powered Gerans and away from cheap decoy swarms. I nudged the median slightly above the recent-month median because (a) the two lowest recent nights (108, 92) fell inside the Sep 5-7 partial capital-strike halt arranged for the Witkoff/Kushner visits and understate the untruced level, (b) jet-UAV output is ramping hard (350 in June -> 1,500 in July -> 2,800 in August per the Air Force spokesperson), and (c) mid-September has in prior years marked the start of the autumn energy-infrastructure campaign. Downside: an active US peace push (Putin met Witkoff/Kushner Sep 5, envoys in Kyiv Sep 6) means a real if small chance of a ceasefire or air truce covering Sep 17-18, which would resolve near 0 - Putin rejected the broader truce, so I price a total-cessation night at ~3%. Upside: Jul 1-2 (~570 combined) and Jul 4-5 (322) show the mass-barrage capability is intact this year, so ~10% above 300 and ~1.2% above the 800 bound (a record-scale retaliatory barrage after talks collapse, as happened in Sept 2025). Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold contract prices this quantity; the harness's three Manifold candidates (2026 ceasefire at 0.14, vol 13.7k; Mearsheimer Russia-attacks-Europe 0.14; Ukraine-attacks-Belarus 0.13) differ on threshold, deadline, resolution source and fine print, so none is an anchor - I used only the 2026-ceasefire price as loose evidence for the zero tail. Main uncertainty is search-sample bias: English coverage over-selects newsworthy nights, so the sub-90 tail may be fatter than my sample shows.
calls.dossier:
RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off the Ukrainian Air Force (Povitryani Syly) daily summary figure for drones LAUNCHED on the night of 17-18 Sep 2026, as reported the morning of 18 Sep Kyiv time via Ukrainska Pravda or credible outlets citing the Air Force - not drones DOWNED, not missiles, not Ukrainian drones fired at Russia. The Air Force posts this summary every morning, typically 08:00-09:30 Kyiv time; a mid-morning figure is often labelled preliminary and later refined. Note (ISW, 5 Sep 2026): the Ukrainian military ceased regularly reporting missile-fired/intercepted counts as of 11 Aug 2026, but continued publishing drone launch counts.

EVENT WINDOW: night of 17 Sep -> morning of 18 Sep 2026 per the criteria; as of Now (2026-09-07T08:35Z) the window has not opened - 0% elapsed, ~10.6 days until it begins.

STATUS-QUO OUTCOME: Russia has conducted a drone attack on essentially every night of the war; the Air Force publishes a launched figure each morning. Absent a change, a summary with a two- or three-digit launched figure appears on the morning of 18 Sep.

BASE RATES BY CLASS (all figures = drones launched per night, Ukrainian Air Force / Ukrainska Pravda / Ukrinform):
- Class 'current jet-Shahed regime, 1 Aug - 7 Sep 2026' (n=12 nights I could source): 92, 108, 133, 147, 147, 150, 152, 163, 167, 217, 218, 258. Median ~155, mean ~163, SD ~47.
- Sub-class 'nights inside the 5-7 Sep partial capital-strike halt' (n=2): 108 (5-6 Sep), 92 (6-7 Sep).
- Sub-class 'nights outside that halt, Aug-early Sep' (n=10): median ~157.
- Class 'Jul 2026' (n=4 sourced): 570 drones-and-missiles combined (1-2 Jul, 524 of 570 targets downed), 322 (4-5 Jul), 94 (8-9 Jul), 94 (19-20 Jul).
- Class 'all Jul-Sep 2026 sourced nights' (n=16): min 92, max ~570; 2 of 16 above 300.
- Class '2025 regime' for contrast: single nights reached 700-810+ drones (e.g. 810 drones on 6-7 Sep 2025); no 2026 night I could source has matched that.
- Composition: on 4-5 Sep 2026, ~half of the 167 were jet-powered (ISW). On the 27 Aug daytime raid, 'more than 100' of ~140 were jet-powered.

EVENT-IN-WINDOW COUNT (11-day windows): in every 11-day window of Aug-Sep 2026 I sampled, at least one night exceeded 200 launched drones (21-22 Aug: 217; 26-27 Aug: 258; 31 Aug-1 Sep: 218). No sourced Aug or Sep 2026 night exceeded 300.

PRODUCTION / TREND (Air Force spokesperson via Ukrainska Pravda, 5 Sep 2026): jet-powered UAVs launched at Ukraine totalled ~350 in June, 1,500 in July, more than 2,800 in August - 'the enemy is ramping up the production and numbers of jet-powered UAVs.' Al Jazeera (4 Sep 2026): propeller drones intercepted at >90%, jet-powered at ~60%; four Ukrainian interceptor types in field trials.

EVIDENCE POINTING TOWARD LOWER COUNTS:
- Aggregate nightly totals in Aug-early Sep 2026 sit well below the July mass-barrage nights and far below 2025 peaks: the shift toward jet drones has come with smaller total salvos, since cheap decoys are being displaced rather than added to.
- Active US mediation: Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in Moscow 5 Sep 2026 (~3 hours, Kremlin aide Ushakov: 'substantive, constructive'), then Zelensky in Kyiv 6 Sep, carrying what Trump called 'a proposal to end the war'.
- Russia and Ukraine agreed a 3-day halt (5-7 Sep) on long-range strikes against Kyiv and Moscow to enable the envoys' travel; the two lowest sourced nights of the period fall inside it.
- Manifold 'Russia x Ukraine ceasefire in 2026?' is an active market with ~13.7k volume (does not match this question's terms).

EVIDENCE POINTING TOWARD HIGHER COUNTS:
- Putin rejected the broader frontline/air ceasefire Ukraine proposed during the envoys' visit (ISW, 5 Sep 2026); Russia continued striking on 5 Sep with 167 drones plus Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistics despite Zelensky's 4 Sep air-truce offer. United24: 'Russia rejects air truce as Trump envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv.'
- Jet-UAV volume has grown ~8x from June to August 2026 and Ukraine's spokesperson frames production as still ramping.
- Mass-barrage capability remains demonstrated in 2026 (570-target night on 1-2 Jul; 322 on 4-5 Jul; ~270 on 28 Mar).
- Prior autumns (2024, 2025) saw Russia escalate long-range strikes from mid-September as the energy-infrastructure campaign opened and nights lengthened.
- Ukraine struck Russia with 800+ drones on 15-16 Aug 2026 (Moscow region; Russia claimed 822 downed, 6 killed) - a precedent for retaliatory escalation cycles.

SEARCHED FOR BUT COULD NOT FIND: any prediction market or bookmaker pricing a Russian per-night drone count (checked Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold - none found; the only Ukraine-related Manifold contracts surfaced concern ceasefire, Belarus, and attacks on Europe); a complete day-by-day Aug-Sep 2026 series (my nightly figures are a search-surfaced subset of ~12 of ~38 nights, likely biased toward nights that drew English-language coverage, so both very quiet and very large nights may be undercounted); the September 2026 month-to-date jet-UAV total; any announced schedule for follow-on Witkoff/Kushner rounds after 6 Sep; any Russian or Ukrainian statement referencing 17-18 September specifically. Also note the question's background text states ~2,800 jet drones were launched 'over the first six days of September 2026' - the primary sources attribute that 2,800 figure to the whole of August 2026, not to early September.

MANIPULATION-SIGNAL NOTE: none observed in the retrieved sources; both belligerents' own casualty/interception claims are self-reported, but the launched-drone count comes from one side's Air Force by construction of the resolution criteria.
calls.reference_class: Single-night Ukrainian Air Force 'drones launched' counts during the jet-Shahed regime of 1 August - 7 September 2026, with the wider July-September 2026 nightly series (which includes mass-barrage nights) as the outer class

calls.reasoning: Reference class is the Ukrainian Air Force morning summary's launched-drone count on individual nights in the current (Jul-Sep 2026) regime: 16 sampled nights run 65-218, median ~144, mean ~139, SD ~35, and the last 11 consecutive nights I could reconstruct (Aug 24-Sep 7) never exceeded 218. I center at ~148 and let the right tail run fat, because a separate massed-barrage regime demonstrably exists in 2026 (Jul 1-2 ~570 drones+missiles; Mar 25 948 over 24h) at roughly 1-2 nights/month, which is what puts the 90th near 295 rather than near the ~185 the normal-regime SD alone implies. The single biggest error mode here is anchoring on aggregate figures: the question background's '~2,800 jet drones in six days' is actually Ihnat's August-2026 monthly total (Ukrainska Pravda, 2026-09-05), and Zelensky's '~1,500 drones Aug 27-30' is ~2.4x the sum of the AF summaries for those same four nights - this resolves off the narrower morning-summary number. Low tail: attacks continued (92, 108) straight through the Witkoff/Kushner Moscow-Kyiv shuttle of Sep 5-7 even while both sides paused capital strikes, and Putin's territorial demands are reported unchanged after an 8-month freeze, so I hold only ~4% near zero for a truce/air-moratorium landing on that specific night. Market check: no contract matches this question; the nearest, Manifold 'Russia x Ukraine ceasefire in 2026' at 0.14 (13.7k volume, closes 2026-12-31), is a full-year ceasefire question and bears only on my zero mass, implying maybe 3-4% in force by Sep 18 - consistent with what I used. p_above_upper 1.5% prices a demonstrative record barrage (mechanism: talks collapse, as in the March 2026 948-drone precedent) exceeding 800.
calls.dossier:
RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT. Resolves off the number of drones the Ukrainian Air Force (Povitryani Syly) says were LAUNCHED in its daily morning summary published the morning of 2026-09-18 Kyiv time, covering the night of 17-18 September 2026 — not off shot-down counts, not off missiles, and NOT off aggregate multi-day or monthly drone figures quoted by officials or by Zelensky, which are measurably a different and much larger series (see bullet 9). The AF publishes this summary daily, typically ~08:00-09:30 Kyiv time, i.e. before the 12:00 UTC scheduled resolution.

EVENT WINDOW: night of 2026-09-17 -> morning of 2026-09-18 per the criteria; as of Now (2026-09-07T08:35Z) the window has NOT begun — 0% elapsed, and it opens in approximately 10.5 days.

STATUS-QUO OUTCOME. Russia has attacked Ukraine with long-range one-way attack drones on essentially every night of the Jul-Sep 2026 period for which reporting exists; the AF published a launched-drone figure on each of those mornings. Absent a change, a summary with a nonzero figure appears on the morning of 18 Sep.

EVIDENCE (source, date):
1. AF daily-summary launched counts, night -> count, Aug-Sep 2026 (Ukrainska Pravda / RBC-Ukraine / ua.news, dated as shown): Aug 6-7: 147 (UP 2026-08-07). Aug 12-13: 133 (UP 2026-08-13). Aug 14-15: 152 (UP 2026-08-15). Aug 17-18: 147 (UP 2026-08-18). Aug 18-19: 65 (UP 2026-08-19). Aug 24-25: 150 (UP 2026-08-25). Aug 26-27: 140 (UP 2026-08-27, described as over the course of the day). Aug 27-28: 164 (UP 2026-08-28). Aug 29-30: 130 (UP 2026-08-30). Aug 30-31: over 120 (UP 2026-08-31). Aug 31-Sep 1: 218 (UP 2026-09-01). Sep 2-3: 163 (Ukrinform 2026-09-03). Sep 3-4: 121 (UP 2026-09-04). Sep 4-5: 167 (UP/RBC 2026-09-05). Sep 5-6: 108 (RBC-Ukraine 2026-09-06). Sep 6-7: 92 (ua.news / UP 2026-09-07).
2. July 2026 same-instrument points: Jul 10-11: 79 drones. Jul 19-20: 94 drones plus two Kh-59/69 (UP 2026-07-20). Jul 27-28: 131 (UP 2026-07-28).
3. A distinct massed-barrage regime exists in 2026: night of Jul 1-2, 2026 saw 570 drones AND missiles combined, 524 downed (UP 2026-07-02); 2026-03-25 saw 948 drones over 24 hours, described as the largest aerial attack of the war to that point, including 400+ in an unusual daytime wave (newsonair, 2026-03-25). Also note 2025 precedents above 570-700 in a night.
4. BASE RATE, class = 'all reconstructed AF-summary nights, Aug 6 - Sep 7 2026' (n=16, bullet 1): median ~144, mean ~139, SD ~35, min 65, max 218. Sorted: 65, 92, 108, ~120, 121, 130, 133, 140, 147, 147, 150, 152, 163, 164, 167, 218.
5. BASE RATE, class = 'the 11 consecutive nights Aug 24-25 through Sep 6-7 2026' (conditional on the most recent tempo, no gaps in this run): 150, 140, 164, 130, 120+, 218, 163, 121, 167, 108, 92 — mean ~143, max 218, no night above 220 in this run.
6. BASE RATE, class = 'monthly totals': Russia deployed 5,059 long-range drones against Ukraine in February 2026, reported as a record month (United24, 2026-02); that is ~181/night averaged. Ihnat: ~2,800 JET-powered drones in August 2026 vs ~1,500 in July 2026 (UP 2026-09-05) — a jet subset, not a nightly total.
7. BASE RATE, class = 'nights above 300 in 2026': identified instances are Feb (record month, individual nights not itemized here), Mar 25 (948/24h), Jul 1-2 (570 drones+missiles). Frequency in the Aug-Sep sample of 16 nights: zero. Searched for but could not find a night above 220 anywhere in Aug 2026 or Sep 1-7 2026.
8. Composition shift: jet-powered Shahed/Geran variants are now roughly half of nightly strikes (TechTimes 2026-09-03; WaPo 2026-09-02; Kyiv Independent). Interception is ~90%+ against propeller drones but ~60% against jet variants (UP 2026-09-05). Jet variants are more expensive per unit — a mechanism arguing for fewer drones per night at constant spend; higher Alabuga output is the mechanism arguing the other way.
9. MEASUREMENT DIVERGENCE, load-bearing: Zelensky said Russia fired almost 1,500 drones at Ukraine between Thursday and Sunday (Aug 27-30), ~800 jet-powered (NPR 2026-08-31). The AF daily summaries for those same four nights sum to ~632 (164 + 130 + 120+ + 218). The two series differ by roughly 2.4x; the resolution instrument is the smaller one.
10. Diplomacy: Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in Moscow ~3 hours on 2026-09-05 with a ceasefire proposal, then held talks in Kyiv on 2026-09-06 (WaPo, Al Jazeera, Axios, CNN, NOTUS, all 2026-09-05/06). Reporting describes the visit as reviving negotiations frozen for nearly eight months, and states Putin's territorial demands remain unchanged and unacceptable to Kyiv. Both sides agreed to hold off aerial attacks on each other's CAPITALS to enable the visits; no broader ceasefire is in place.
11. Attacks continued through that diplomatic window: 167 (Sep 4-5), 108 (Sep 5-6), 92 (Sep 6-7) — i.e. the capital-strike pause did not produce a zero or near-zero national total. Separately, a Ukrainian unilateral pause on offensive operations Sep 5-8 did not stop Russian strikes.
12. Escalation context in the window: a Russian drone strike on an ammunition warehouse near Kyiv killed at least 38 on 2026-08-29 (CNN); UN monitors confirmed 1,396 Ukrainian civilians killed and 7,978 injured in H1 2026, a sharp rise attributed to increased long-range strikes (UN News, 2026-08).
13. Reciprocal tempo (context, not the resolved quantity): Ukraine's largest attack of the year on Russia was 2026-08-15/16, with Russia's MoD claiming 822 drones destroyed (CNN, TIME, NPR, TASS via those); 456 Ukrainian drones claimed downed on 2026-08-10 (France 24).
14. Historical low end: nights as low as 53 drones have been reported by the AF in this conflict; the lowest in the Aug-Sep 2026 sample is 65 (Aug 18-19). No night with a reported total of zero was found anywhere in the Jul-Sep 2026 period.

calls.reference_class: Single-night Russian drone-launch totals as stated in the Ukrainian Air Force's daily morning summary, over the July-September 2026 regime (n=16 reconstructed nights), treated as a mixture of a routine-tempo component and a low-frequency massed-barrage component

calls.reasoning: Status quo is a near-nightly attack with a two-to-three-digit AF launched figure published each morning; no zero-drone night was found anywhere in Jul-Sep 2026. The reconstructed current-regime series centers at ~147 with a max of ~218-258 over roughly five weeks, including an 11-night gapless stretch that never exceeded 218 - and since large barrages are the MOST covered events in English media, search-sample bias argues the hidden nights are quiet ones, not big ones. I center at 157 rather than 147 because the two lowest recent nights (108, 92) fell inside the Sep 5-7 capital-strike halt for the Witkoff/Kushner shuttle and understate the untruced level, jet-UAV output has ramped ~8x June-to-August, and mid-September has opened the autumn energy-infrastructure campaign in prior years. I do NOT push the median or the p90 higher on officials' aggregate claims: the AF daily summaries for Aug 27-30 sum to ~632 against Zelensky's ~1,500 for the same nights, a ~2.4x different series, and the question background's '2,800 jet drones in six days' is in fact Ihnat's August monthly total. The right tail stays fat but bounded - 2026's clean overnight drone precedents above 300 are thin (Jul 4-5 at 322; Mar 25's 948 was a 24-hour figure, Jul 1-2's 570 was drones plus missiles) - putting ~6-7% above 300 and ~1.2% above the 800 bound for a record retaliatory barrage after talks collapse. Low tail ~3.5% near zero: Putin rejected the broader truce and strikes continued through the envoys' visit, and the nearest market (Manifold 2026 ceasefire, 0.14, ~13.7k volume, closes Dec 31) implies only ~3-4% in force by Sep 18 - evidence for the zero mass only, not an anchor, since it differs on threshold, deadline, source and fine print.
calls.reconciliation: Three disputes were load-bearing. (1) Run 1's p90 of 485 rests explicitly on Ihnat's '>1,500 UAVs over four days'; Run 3 checked that same class of claim against the resolution instrument and found the AF summaries for Aug 27-30 sum to ~632 vs Zelensky's ~1,500 for identical nights - the aggregate series is ~2.4x the instrument, so it cannot be used to infer nightly levels. That refutes Run 1's tail rationale and I do not carry its dispersion of 400 forward. (2) The prompt's own background ('~2,800 jet drones over the first six days of September') was independently traced by Runs 2 and 3 to Ukrainska Pravda 2026-09-05 as the AUGUST monthly total, and fails an arithmetic check against the Sep 1-7 nightly sum (~870) - I treat the background's 'several hundred per night' framing as an artifact. (3) The Aug 26-27 count is genuinely disputed (140 vs 162 vs 258) and I had no web access to settle it; I let it carry its uncertainty, which it can afford because all three values sit inside the reconciled central mass. On judgment: Runs 1 and 2 read search-sample bias as hiding LARGE nights; I take the opposite reading, since barrages draw the most English coverage and Run 3's 11 consecutive gapless nights (max 218) is the single strongest piece of evidence in the dossiers against a concealed 300+ night in the current regime - that is a judgment call no evidence fully breaks, and it is the one I would bet on. I carry Run 3's reference class forward (densest, gapless) but not its median: its 148 does not fully credit pause mean-reversion plus the autumn-campaign onset, both of which all three runs endorse. Net result is a median between Runs 2 and 3, a p90 below all three, and a 10-90 width of 194 that sits between Runs 2 (210) and 3 (195). No web retrieval was performed on this run.

calls.reference_class: Ukrainian Air Force morning-summary launched-drone counts for single overnight attacks in the current jet-Shahed regime (Aug 6 - Sep 7, 2026), n~16-17 nights pooled across the three runs: 65, 92, 108, ~120, 121, 130, 133, 140/162/258 (disputed Aug 26-27), 147, 147, 150, 152, 163, 164, 167, 217, 218
